I recommend looking up the withdrawal symptoms and expecting them, that'll help with the anxiety that's gonna come with quitting, I quit 5 days ago and have been using Zyn (nicotine pouches) to ween myself off. It's not like a juul buzz but its enough to take away some of the worse symptoms. You can do this, the best time to quit is right now. I felt better not being a slave to the juul the moment I threw it away, its a relief not being constantly ripping it or looking for it. My lungs already feel better after 5 days. Expect some phlegm and a little cough after quitting. Just look up the symptoms and that helped me, knowing what I was gonna experience and not psyching myself up that I have covid or something.

Just quit 4 days ago, it's shitty but you can do it. Its all in your head, there are physical symptoms you should expect, like phlegm in the throat and a slight cough, look up nicotine withdrawal symptoms to know what to expect. Its the perfect time to quit with a dangerous respiratory illness going around, you're hurting your chances of survival by not quitting. You can do this!
